description:
Planning only; no implementation authorized. Confirmed requirements: Data > Labels entry; definitions have name, description, supported targets documents/chunks, independent automatic setting per target gated by configured Decision model. One free-text value per label/resource. Manual values take precedence over automatic results for an existing resource. Re-ingestion explicitly deletes all previous chunks and their assignments, including manual values; newly created chunks are labeled afresh when automation is enabled and a Decision model is configured. Ingestion rows show name/value chips and open one reusable resource label editor. Ingested details show chunk starts in rendered Markdown, chunk names and value chips, and open that same editor for the selected chunk.

Proposed UX: Labels list plus create/edit definition form; resource editor identifies document/chunk, lists applicable definitions, supports value changes and reset to automatic, saves atomically and returns to prior context/scroll. No-value labels remain editable but do not produce value chips. Explain unavailable automation and link to model configuration. Separate pending/failed classification status from label values. Read-only users cannot mutate; authorize resource access server-side.

Confirmed lifecycle decisions (2026-11-02): Automatic labeling runs during ingestion for enabled target types only when a Decision model is configured. Without one, skip the labeling step and continue ingestion/chunk creation. The label description is the instruction for extracting its single free-text value. Users may edit automatically generated values afterwards; manual edits win for the lifetime of that chunk. Re-ingestion deletes all old chunks and their label assignments, including manual edits, and creates fresh chunks with fresh automatic values when eligible. Do not migrate chunk overrides across re-ingestion. Label definitions remain available. Late jobs for deleted chunks must not recreate assignments or write to replacement chunks.

Open product contracts: document-level manual value retention on re-ingestion (the confirmed reset applies to chunks); existing-resource backfill; definition deletion/target removal; exact permissions; manually cleared values and explicit reset UX. The description guides extraction, but the selected Decision model still needs verified free-text extraction support: current configuration advertises decisions output and is saved-only, not an implemented inference pipeline. Proposed defaults not yet approved: no inherited document values on chunks; archive definitions.

Verified source evidence: lib/zaq/ingestion/document_chunker.ex annotates source positions; document_processor.ex persists start_line in chunk metadata. lib/zaq_web/components/design_system/ingestion_details.ex renders IngestionProgress and FilePreview.panel. IngestionLive requests get_ingestion_details using an Event and NodeRouter. Reuse source metadata and existing modal/preview boundaries. Still investigate rendering anchors for tables/code/repeated text, same-line starts, Unicode, missing old metadata and stale content revisions.

Action reuse assessment: current task is product discovery, with no executable changes. Implementation audit remains incomplete and blocks an executable plan. Inspected registry, data_source UpdateDocument and Ingestion API for label/classification operations; no matching operation established. Before implementation inspect all relevant Actions/workflow Steps/domain APIs and configured Decision-model resolver; classify definition management, value assignment/reset, automatic classification and bulk read projection individually as reuse/extend/new Action/local-only. New essential Actions need prerequisite issues; all BO cross-service calls use NodeRouter and trusted actor context. No automatic agent tool exposure.

Next planning step after product decisions: create dependency-linked implementation issues with owning modules, operation contracts, test-first cases, external dependency seams and documentation updates per docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md. Include manual-vs-auto race protection, retries/stale result rejection, resource deletion and re-ingestion, permission negatives, safe rendering and source span properties. Plan implementation -> human UX approval -> consolidated E2E, plus post-review coverage handoff. This issue is a discovery brief, not an execution-ready implementation plan. No tests run: planning only.
